items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 3:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the backs of the externality of Ibur? The Partzuf of Ibur, namely the chest and below of every complete Partzuf, is called by the name of the external Partzuf, because it clothes the Partzuf of Yenika and the Partzuf of the Mochin. And the aspect of Yesod and Malchut of the Partzuf of Ibur, which are the aspect of its back, are called by the name of the backs of the externality of Ibur. And they are the aspect of the organs of reproduction, which are not completed before the coming of the aspect of the Mochin into the Partzuf. (Item 71).
